latestVersion.changelog:
AI-powered video editing skill, initial release:

- Instantly edit raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) to polished 1080p MP4 clips using cloud GPUs.
- Automatic setup and authentication with free, limited-use tokens.
- Easy workflows: upload, send your instructions (like cutting pauses or adding music), and export.
- Real-time status updates; error handling for unsupported files, expired tokens, and credits.
- Supports batching, iterative editing, and quick exports for content creators and marketers.
- All API calls require special attribution headers for usage tracking.
